definitions: A call to someone to participate in a competitive situation or fight to decide who is superior.
A difficult task or situation that tests someone's abilities.
A formal objection to the fairness or legality of something.
A formal objection to a juror or jury.
A formal objection to a vote or election result.
examples: The project was a real challenge.
They issued a challenge to the ruling.
The defence made a challenge to the juror.
The party mounted a legal challenge to the election.
